verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents official Python and TypeScript SDK references (docs-38, docs-65, docs-64), and its SDK index says the SDKs log traces from your code (docs-63). The official JavaScript SDK repo exists (gh-1, gh-3), and the Python `wrap_openai` drop-in wrapper automatically logs LLM calls (docs-36), backed by general instrumentation docs (docs-1, docs-15). Missing for 10: a JS/TS-specific tracing or auto-instrumentation example (the GitHub snippets show evals only), and independent hands-on corroboration of instrumentation in both languages.
